definitions.explanation: Going on and on without stopping, said of tears, talk, thoughts, or feelings. Written {止|と}め{処|ど}ない; the kana spelling is usual.

examples.japanese: とめどない⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とめどなく⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Her talk went on and on without end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、とめどなく⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あふれてくる。
examples.english: Looking at old photos, memories keep pouring out without end.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- とめどなく⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧: tears that keep flowing
- とめどなく⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to talk on and on
- とめどない⟦{欲望|よくぼう}→欲望：05086_yokubou⟧: endless desire

FORMS:
From ⟦{止|と}め→止める：00678_tomeru⟧{処|ど} (a place to stop) + ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧. The adverb form とめどなく is the most common use. とめど⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ is a variant with the same meaning.

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: とめどなくなかったら
